board: Keyes / Joy-IT KY-002 vibration switch module (SEN-KY002, also sold as HW-513; header S, + (middle), -)
reason: Modelled as an active-low spring-in-tube switch from S to GND with the on-board 10 kOhm pull-up from + to S (S LOW while shaken), with a debounced falling-edge IRQ driver; check passed on ESP32 and Pico on the first run.
breakoutPinoutSource: https://arduinomodules.info/ky-002-vibration-switch-module/ (S, middle +, -); https://sensorkit.joy-it.net/en/sensors/ky-002 (Signal, +V, GND; pull-up, LOW/falling edge on shock); https://zazuzx.wordpress.com/2016/09/07/ky-002-vibration-sensor/ (resistor between VCC and S, LOW on contact)
